messages.text:
1st, Ada-mant, earlier today it popped into my mind that between the Quacksink archive and Luma's loving attention I can probably learn calculus.  I thrashed around for WHY THE FUCK WOULD I WANT TO. Came up with a few sorta good reasons.  But then I realized I had a perfect reason.  For love.  Not out of love of mathmatics itself (although I do have that to some degree) But out of love for Ada, for once learn calculus I can use it speak in a language she loves and understands. 💕
